causal_chain: Engine tears down the actual Context and Runtime before releasing its native-memory-owner entitlement.
Native TransferData allocation owns an additional prefix entitlement from pi_simd::allocate; it does not retain Engine or JS objects.
pi_simd::release reads only its prefix memory_owner and charge, frees the allocation, decrements actual atomic memory accounting, and releases its own domain entitlement.
The final atomic domain release destroys the domain only when the actual reference count reaches zero. The packet can therefore retire after Engine on a different thread with context=NULL.
StrongHandle is a distinct receiver-thread BaseObjectPtr edge over the existing State; it does not share the native descriptor packet cross-thread freedom.
qualification: Source derivation and unexecuted focused controls only. Actual native execution remains separately gated.
